title: QPL content schemas + minimal CI structural check
context: question-prompt-lists enforces safety and quality via machine-checkable schema constraints, not just prose policy. The Hee-Lee Oss schema package (packages/schema/src/schemas.ts) already exports taskSchema and registrySchema; this task extends it with content schemas for QPL artifacts. The structural CI check is the last line of machine defense before expert review: it must reject any set file that is missing the mandatory disclaimer, missing provenance on a flagged assertion, missing the dual review sign-off block, missing a nextReviewDue date, or (for sensitive topics) missing verified support resources. These checks run on every PR so reviewers never receive an artifact that fails the mechanical gates.
objective: Add qplSetSchema, qplQuestionSchema, sourceAllowListSchema, taxonomySchema, supportResourceSchema, and reviewSchema to packages/schema/src/schemas.ts (and re-export from index), then wire a structural-check script (run via pnpm test) that parses every YAML artifact in sets/, sources/, taxonomy/, and support/ to JSON and fails CI on missing required fields.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/schema/src/schemas.ts exports qplSetSchema, qplQuestionSchema, sourceAllowListSchema, taxonomySchema, supportResourceSchema, and reviewSchema, each with additionalProperties:false and all required fields from the PLAN data model section

qplSetSchema enforces: disclaimer field (non-empty string), provenance array (minItems:1), review object with clinician and advocate sign-off sub-fields, nextReviewDue date string, and supportResources array required when any question has a sensitivity field
qplQuestionSchema enforces: no answer, recommendation, or prognosis field (additionalProperties:false excludes them); required id, text, topic, provenanceRefs

A structural-check script (scripts/check-content.ts or similar) is wired into pnpm test; it validates all YAML files in sets/, sources/, taxonomy/, support/ against their respective schemas and exits non-zero on any failure
pnpm build && pnpm test pass on a green repo state with the seed allow-list and taxonomy files present
PR includes a brief comment explaining each schema and the CI gate behavior
resources: PLAN.md (Solution approach — data model, Artifacts section)
TASKS.md (qpl-schema-001 row; CI gate requirements from qpl-license-001 AC)
qpl-taxonomy-001 (taxonomySchema must match the vocabulary files produced there)
output: Modified packages/schema/src/schemas.ts with six new exported schemas; scripts/check-content.ts (or equivalent); updated pnpm test wiring; PR to packages/schema
